headline: Sky Sports sticking Everton vs Newcastle behind the red button last night shows how little they care about the non big six
body: Sure plenty of people noticed this last night that the game between Everton and Newcastle could only be accessed by the red button on Sky Sports +. Tennis took priority on main event which is fine enough but they had Sky Sports football available which normally shows EFL Cup, instead they just showed reruns of the other games. Does it show that they care very little about the ones outside the top 6? Remember when TNT was putting smaller clubs behind an extra paywall during the pandemic?   submitted by   /u/GMD3S1GNS [link]   [comments]
